title: Sundar Pichai on Google launching Gemini 4 Argon, its most powerful AI model yet

The model targets coding, legal, finance and cybersecurity work, with a 1 million token output limit. It is rolling out first to cyber defenders via the Fairwind Program, with paid API users and Google AI Ultra subscribers next in line.

title: Stephen King foundation gave $120,000 to help heat Maine homes during winter

This initiative, which garnered a total of $241,820, emerged in response to concerns regarding reduced federal assistance. Many households face the chilling threat of inadequate heating during the harsh winter months, highlighting the vital community spirit that seeks to protect those in financial hardship.

title: How Maria Sharapova built a $220 million fortune beyond tennis

Her estimated $220 million fortune has been tied to career earnings, global endorsements, Sugarpova and investments in consumer, wellness, fitness and technology companies, allowing the five-time Grand Slam champion to build a financial portfolio outside of professional tennis.

title: Tyreek Hill next team: Vikings and Packers emerge as possible landing spots

This could mean the Minnesota Vikings, as Justin Jefferson is suffering from an ankle injury. It could also be the Green Bay Packers, since Jayden Reed is out for the season.

title: ‘Fatal point of no return’: Putin warns against use of nukes amid global tensions
content: Vladimir Putin expressed concerns about current global tensions and the potential for disastrous outcomes from escalating conflicts. He emphasized the importance of preventing the use of weapons of mass destruction in international disputes. Putin highlighted the role of Western technical support in Ukraine's military actions against Russia. He stated that Russia is not planning attacks on European countries but would respond to any aggression.

title: Massachusetts couple wins $310,000 judgment in neighbour tree dispute
content: A Massachusetts couple achieved a remarkable win in their legal battle against their neighbor, successfully advocating for themselves in court. They were awarded $310,000 for damages due to tree destruction and unauthorized encroachments. The ruling by the Massachusetts Appeals Court upheld their victory, emphasizing that self-represented individuals can indeed confront intricate legal issues effectively. This judgment concludes a drawn-out conflict over property rights and associated damages.

title: UK-Iranian man arrested over security incident at US-run military base in England
content: A UK-Iranian dual national was arrested in London over a security incident linked to RAF Fairford. The incident followed the arrest of five British men suspected of preparing a terrorist act. Authorities are investigating potential foreign state involvement, particularly from Iran, which has denied any connection. UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham has indicated strong signs suggesting Iran's role in the incident.

title: India, Pakistan, Australia in same group for 2027 ODI World Cup

The tournament is set to take place in South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Namibia, starting on October 2 and concluding on November 21. A total of 14 teams will participate, divided into two groups of six after a preliminary stage.

title: Unimaginable grief: 8 Pune students on school picnic drown at Diveagar beach
content: A picnic at Diveagar beach turned tragic when eight students from Pune drowned after being swept away. They misjudged the sea's depth and current strength, leading to their distress. Local authorities and rescue teams responded promptly to recover all eight bodies. Maharashtra ministers expressed their condolences and sought details regarding the incident. Legal and administrative procedures are currently being conducted at the site of the tragedy.

title: 'Smiling & laughing': India's envoy to UAE meets flydubai hero pilot Smit Machchhar
content: Indian ambassador Deepak Mittal visited Captain Smit Machchhar at the hospital following the stabbing incident. Captain Machchhar was attacked by his co-pilot while flying from Dubai to Tel Aviv. After the initial treatment in Saudi Arabia, he was airlifted to Abu Dhabi for further medical care. Passengers and two other pilots helped to restrain the attacker and safely landed the flight.

title: Flydubai incident: Indian pilot stable, co-pilot in custody; Saudi, UAE launch probes
content: On a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight, the Omani co-pilot allegedly attacked the captain in the cockpit. Indian captain Smit Machchhar sustained serious injuries but managed to unlock the cockpit door. Passengers intervened and overpowered the co-pilot, ensuring the safety of everyone aboard. The flight was diverted to Saudi Arabia, where all 174 people landed safely. Investigations by authorities from Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Israel are ongoing.

title: Dubai-London flight diverted to Frankfurt after passenger’s medical emergency
content:
Flight EK31 was diverted to Frankfurt, where the aircraft landed safely (Photo: Reuters).

An Emirates flight from Dubai to London Heathrow was diverted to Frankfurt after a passenger suffered a medical emergency on board, the airline said. Flight EK31 landed safely in Frankfurt, where the passenger disembarked to receive further medical attention. Emirates said its cabin crew assisted the passenger during the flight and medical support was arranged upon arrival. The flight was expected to resume its journey to London Heathrow at around 6pm local time, the airline said. The diversion came a day after a flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv was diverted to Saudi Arabia following an alleged cockpit attack, in which one pilot reportedly stabbed the other in an apparent attempt to crash the aircraft.

title: Introduced Nile perch devastated Lake Victoria’s native cichlids and fishery
content: the decision was intended to create new commercial opportunities and increase the supply of valuable fish . instead, the species spread through one of the world’s largest freshwater ecosystems and became linked to a dramatic decline in native fish species . a well-intentioned fisheries decision can produce consequences that extend far beyond its original goal .

title: CBI names 3 senior ADAG execs, 7 companies in 2nd RHFL chargesheet
content: the chargesheet alleges criminal conspiracy and cheating that led to massive wrongful losses for a consortium of public sector banks and financial institutions . the charges include three senior executives of the Reliance ADA Group and seven corporate entities .

title: ‘No explicit request’: BAPS gets clean chit in Eiffel Tower women staff row
content: the investigation found no explicit request from the religious group to exclude female staff during its delegation’s visit to the Eiffel Tower . in a statement, BAPS France reiterated that it had never asked for female employees to be hidden, removed or excluded . the investigation establishes this fact that BAPS made no such request for women to be excluded along the visitor route.

title: Monterey Bay Aquarium has cared for over 1,000 stranded sea otters
content: a $57 million gift from David and Lucile Packard helped turn a former cannery site into the Monterey Bay Aquarium . the aquarium has welcomed more than 70 million visitors and developed major programmes in marine science and education . it has cared for more than 1,000 stranded sea otters and successfully surrogate-raised 84 pups for release into the wild .

title: Government backs SCO connectivity, but PM's Pakistan visit uncertain
content: the first such visit from India to Pakistan since the 2025 terrorist attack has sparked speculation about whether PM Modi would travel to Pakistan for the heads of state summit next year . officials said his attendance is no guarantee of a visit even for a multilateral event to Pakistan, a country India has come to describe as a serial practitioner of terrorism .

title: Supreme Court judges decline to meet parliamentary panel on one-nation, one-election
content: the bill proposes simultaneous Lok Sabha and assembly polls . it was introduced in the parliamentary committee in 2024 . opposition parties are critical of the bill, alleging it is unconstitutional and violates federal rights . the proposed amendment could become subject matter of judicial review .

title: Supreme Court refuses to de-freeze TMC accounts, says let Calcutta high court decide
content: the suprem court rejected a petition by Mamata Banerjee-headed faction seeking de-freezing of its three bank accounts . the party required funds to carry out political activities, such as holding rallies and meetings . a senior advocate said the party's three accounts should be allowed to be operated by the party .

title: PFRDA plans direct pension fund investment in big infrastructure projects
content: the pension fund Regulatory and Development Authority is preparing a roadmap to allow entities regulated by it to invest directly in large infrastructure projects . the current mechanism of investing through ReITS, InVITS and alternate investment funds (AIFs) a committee has been set up to look at the issue, chairman says .
